notes.title: Magnus Positive Phototaxis - Winter Sale 2023
notes.notes:
Hi, 

This year, on the occasion of the Steam Winter Sale, we have prepared a discount on our game -57%.

Yesterday we released our game: Lazarus A.D. 2222, which combines the games from the Magnus series in a unique way.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451460/Lazarus_AD_2222/

We especially recommend playing the entire series, which can be an interesting, metaphorical journey into yourself for you. With a touch of good humour, of course.
This is an interesting idea to spend time in the coming days.

On the occasion of the Witer Sale, we have a bundle with Lazarus A.D. 2222 for you:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37548/Phototaxis_and_Lazarus/

Have a great trip!
